scope: CPU-only independent read/recomputation of existing reports; no simulation, training or policy acceptance.

mismatch_analysis.training: Sticky failure uses root x/y square +/-5.4m.
mismatch_analysis.evaluation: Any wheel center outside x[-0.6,5.4] or y[-0.9,0.9] fails.
mismatch_analysis.consequence: Training can count safe episodes whose wheel footprints fail evaluation. Code mismatch is verified; training boundary failure counts were not saved.

mismatch_analysis.training: Integrate displacement along command direction rotated by actual yaw, only during nonzero linear command. Success progress >=max(0.5*expected,1m); promote >=80% of >=100 episodes.
mismatch_analysis.evaluation: World +x route max >=3m; >=95% success separately for traverse/stand/turn with RMS gates.
mismatch_analysis.consequence: Level2 does not imply corridor/route acceptance; curved routes or1.8m approach can satisfy training.

mismatch_analysis.training: Rough x0,y+/-0.1,yaw+/-0.025,roll/pitch+/-0.1; configured noise/randomization and geometry seed2026091970.
mismatch_analysis.evaluation: Upright roll/pitch0, matching x/y/yaw/command schedule; frozen nominal/bounded physics and geometry seed2026091980.
mismatch_analysis.consequence: Route v1 fixes major command/time mismatch, while reset/geometry/physics intentionally differ. Do not erase robustness coverage to fit disclosed cases.

mismatch_analysis.training: Actor57 has angular velocity/gravity/commands/joints/previous action; no explicit root linear velocity, heading or position.
mismatch_analysis.consequence: Precision can reduce integrated drift; absolute heading/position feedback or history/estimator requires separately qualified architecture/ABI.

reward_analysis.interpretation: 0.05m/s sustained bias costs ~1% of broad linear kernel while accumulating~1m/20s. This motivates a sharper Rough-only tracking experiment, not a proven causal optimizer diagnosis.

decision.recommended_next_causal_experiment: Fresh paired seeds from qualified Flat anchor with fresh Rough critics and bounded staged budget. Test Rough-only precision linear tracking as the primary correction; preserve Flat rewards, commands, tilt termination, actor57 ABI, PPO/drift contract and all quality gates. Any additional yaw precision change must be declared as a coupled objective rather than claimed as an isolated linear ablation.
decision.reason: Forward nearest-root-boundary proxy1146/1888 dominates;742 negative-y cases remain. Reference/anchor random0 failures are all corridor. Old58 random0 has lower vx bias and100/99 successes, supporting precision hypothesis while exposing large seed variance.
decision.reference_use: Original reference stays immutable comparator and ancestor of Flat anchor54; random0 reference42/45 is not accepted Rough teacher. Do not distill overspeed blindly. Old58 is evidence, not permission to hide57 or choose a lucky seed.
decision.diagnostic_instrumentation: Future first-failure telemetry should save exact failed wheel/boundary, wheel xyz, quaternion and pre-failure tracking/geometry. Route-aware curriculum counters are useful diagnostics; do not silently change promotion or quality thresholds.
decision.acceptance: Disclosed regression cases support comparison; only after full paired pass freeze recipe and run new qualification seeds/cases. No hardware actuation.

limitations: Nearest-root-boundary is a geometric proxy, not exact wheel-boundary attribution: first_failure lacks wheel poses/quaternion. Boundary-distance near ties can misclassify.

Rough RMS/bias, clearance/energy/slip accumulate through the full replay, including after first failure. Tracking uses20s after2s settle. No pre-failure velocity series exists; do not infer causal ordering from full-episode bias. First-failure time/root are recorded directly.
Success-only bias is descriptive selection, not acceptance. Pooled data cannot replace each seed/profile/kind gate.
Reference/anchor cover random0 only. Old and new cases are disclosed regression data, not independent qualification.
